what: false-reject check of the PostOnly rule on real ACCEPTED orders; not a validation of the real reject rate

definitions.fresh_book: last recorded depth event at most 2.0 s before the probe
definitions.fresh_book_short_lived: fresh_book and order lifetime (updatedTime - createdTime) <= 5.0 s: unlikely to carry an amended price
definitions.stale_book: last depth event older than the fresh limit: the collector was not recording, the rebuilt book is not the market

limits: the export keeps one final record per order: if the bot amended an order, `price` is the last price, not the price at creation
the recorded book has collector gaps; probes inside them say nothing about the rule
every order here was accepted by the exchange (it filled): this measures false rejects only, never missed rejects
rule: buy: price >= best ask; sell: price <= best bid, book just before the first event with exchange_ts >= probe time
